name: io.github.openmoca/moca-mcp
title: MOCA
description: Search and cite MOCA knowledge packages, verified and with citation records, on your machine.

packageArguments.name: --library
packageArguments.description: A folder of MOCA packages (.moca files or package folders) to serve. Indexes beside them are used by name.

packageArguments.name: --trust-root
packageArguments.description: A trust root JSON file: the keys whose signatures and reviews count. Without one, nothing is reported as signed or reviewed.

packageArguments.name: --audience
packageArguments.description: The audiences this assistant may serve, comma-separated, such as public. Pages for other audiences are never returned.
